description: Returns ranked program recommendations from the organization library (12 by default; limit sets 1 to 20). Use when the user wants instant program suggestions. Not for making a new program (use generate_program).

end_user_fitness_levels.description: Member's fitness level as a one-item list, e.g. ["intermediate"]. Values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

end_user_goal_ids.description: Member's goal IDs from list_team_goals, e.g. ["63c92926f920a9005c4e619c"].

limit.description: How many ranked results to show, 1 to 20. Defaults to 12.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

name: recommend_plans
title: Recommend plans
